title: AAuth Budgets test vectors
description: Deterministic Budgets cases that aauth-go and aauth-rust both compute, checked against draft-hardt-aauth-budgets at commit 70d67375deb0bb002af7da0711fc58f6e8926e7e (3 October 2026).
A vector is published only when both libraries agree. disagreements lists the cases they do not agree on. Those entries are findings, not expected results.
Serializations record each library's header field or compact budget JSON. The expected value is the parsed members. Member order is not significant.
Evaluate a vector with no network: run the operation in input and compare it with expect. vectors/budgets/README.md describes every member.

generated.harness: cmd/budget-vectors, driver-go against budgets and testutil.NewBudgetStore, driver-rust against aauth-rust-budgets

disagreements.title: Cost and reserved together
disagreements.basis: Budgets line 623: reserved is meaningful where cost is not yet known. The draft does not forbid both on one field.

disagreements.title: Required equal to remaining
disagreements.basis: Budgets line 624: required is the maximum cost of a request that did not fit. The draft does not say the member must be greater than remaining.

disagreements.title: Cost and required together
disagreements.basis: Budgets lines 622 and 624. A refusal carries no cost (line 724).

disagreements.title: Format cost and remaining above the grant
disagreements.basis: Budgets lines 621-622. The draft does not say a sender must reject a field whose figures sum above the grant.

disagreements.title: Trailer cost above the reserved hold
disagreements.basis: Budgets lines 676 and 909. The balance formula subtracts cost from remaining plus reserved. The draft does not say a trailer parser must reject cost above reserved.

disagreements.title: Reserve a hold of zero
disagreements.basis: Budgets line 623. The draft does not say whether a zero hold is a reservation.

disagreements.title: Hold above 15 digits
disagreements.basis: Budgets line 323: derived figures stay inside the 15-digit carrier.
